criterion: Stop 拒絕新資料、期限內排空；下游停滯時依期限回報未完成並安全取消；不釋放仍持有的記憶體。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Stop refuses new data, drains until its deadline, reports remaining work and safely cancels/releases holds. Required finding for the counterexample: Deadline expiry alone frees an outstanding consumer reference: FLOW-STOP-001 failure.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
